description: Authorizes the merge of one GitHub pull request, owner/repo#number, through the GitHub connector (github:pr-merge). A merge needs a signed human approval for that exact pull request and that exact head commit (the expectedHeadSha). If the head has moved since the approval, the merge is refused. The caller-declared safety facts can refuse a merge, never authorize one. A merge is refused when no head commit is given, when the branch is not protected, the repository is not authorized, required reviews are not complete, a status check is not passing, or the risk score is above 3.

outcome.reason: Refused: no signed approval covers merging this pull request at this head commit.
Refused: the merge does not name the head commit the approver reviewed (expectedHeadSha).
Refused: the branch, reviews, status checks or repository do not meet the merge requirements.
Refused: the risk score is above 3.
Merge approved: a signed approval covers this pull request at this head commit.
Refused: the target is not a pull request reference.
